scope: Read-only current source base-part architecture audit; frozen installed 0.1.0 package declaration sites checked separately; no component edits or performance claims.

entries.responsibilities: flex layout, isolation, slot projection
entries.opportunity: Host can own flex column and isolation; retain slot and slotchange listener. Rewrite slotted focus stacking selectors.
entries.acceptance: Slot membership, cancellation, nested focus stacking and all item states.

entries.responsibilities: bordered section around heading/button/panel
entries.opportunity: Host can own border/min-size. Keep heading, native trigger and panel together in shadow for aria-controls; section has no accessible name today.
entries.acceptance: Heading levels, trigger/panel ID relationship, expanded state, disabled and focus ring.

entries.responsibilities: grid layout over list, controls, slots, announcements
entries.opportunity: Host can own grid/gap; leave list/virtual scroll boundaries and announcements intact. Does not eliminate rows or hidden load controls.
entries.acceptance: List versus virtual/paginated modes; scroll anchoring, retained focus and live updates.

entries.responsibilities: named focusable article inside listitem wrapper
entries.opportunity: Prefer move listitem to host and keep native article; alternatively move article role to host only when external listitem remains. One host cannot be both article and listitem.
entries.acceptance: Embedded versus standalone list semantics, article navigation, focus(), metadata slot fallback.

entries.responsibilities: flex surface, variant and closed visibility
entries.opportunity: Host can own flex/border/variant/visibility; keep stable content live region and native dismiss button. Do not hide host by overwriting an author-owned hidden attribute without a policy.
entries.acceptance: Announcements across updates, dismiss cancellation, focus on dismissed controls, icon slot presence and SSR.

entries.responsibilities: flex surface, padding/border/background/shadow around three regions
entries.opportunity: Host can own entire surface layout; retain header/content/footer initially. Investigate absent optional region wrappers separately with slot discovery and SSR identity preserved.
entries.acceptance: Actual showcase ::part(base) override, fill-height cards, spacing, nested cards, optional slots and hydration.

entries.responsibilities: group/name/position, inert/aria-hidden and slide surface
entries.opportunity: Host can own surface and default group semantics, but inert/hidden policy must distinguish internal visibility from consumer attributes; preserve authored children identity.
entries.acceptance: Offscreen focus exclusion, visible set announcements, nested controls, scroll geometry and full-height slides.

entries.responsibilities: named group/surface for editor and actions
entries.opportunity: Host can own default group semantics/surface; native editing and send controls remain. focus() must still target the editor adapter.
entries.acceptance: IME, native edit controls, validity, custom send slot, cancelable send and editor focus.

entries.responsibilities: named article and explicit focus() target
entries.opportunity: Move role=article/name/surface to host only with article accessibility and focus API redesign; keep native article as lower-risk default.
entries.acceptance: Article navigation/name, focus() without permanent Tab stop, outgoing style and rich slots.

entries.responsibilities: named group/grid/sizing around controls
entries.opportunity: Host can own default group semantics and layout; keep field/slider/native controls and existing forwarded parts. Larger savings likely lie in optional panels rather than one base.
entries.acceptance: Color spaces, responsive grid, all nested channel controls, validity and focus delegation.

entries.responsibilities: named group/grid around pointer plane and keyboard equivalents
entries.opportunity: Host can own group and layout; retain pointer plane gesture target and accessible equivalent sliders.
entries.acceptance: Pointer capture/geometry, keyboard equivalents, labels, alpha toggle and exact input errors.

entries.responsibilities: named group/grid around wheel and sliders
entries.opportunity: Host can own group/layout; retain wheel gesture target and accessible slider controls.
entries.acceptance: Wheel geometry, pointer capture, Hue alternatives, alpha and disabled state.

entries.responsibilities: popover surface, layout, placement geometry and keydown boundary
entries.opportunity: Popover can be host-owned in principle, but this moves top-layer participation, imperative geometry and all base references. Keep as separate measured redesign, not simple wrapper deletion.
entries.acceptance: showPopover/hidePopover, selection rect, docking, clipping, focus, Escape, inline/contextual modes.

entries.responsibilities: SVG viewport, stroke and accessible image contract
entries.opportunity: Base is the actual SVG, not an extra HTML wrapper. A custom HTML host cannot replace its SVG namespace/viewBox rendering. Investigate paths or repeated host use independently.
entries.acceptance: Do not count SVG base as removable wrapper; preserve meaningful/decorative naming and RTL mirroring.

entries.responsibilities: named native nav inside optional details disclosure
entries.opportunity: Host could supply navigation semantics but then landmark moves outside responsive details and must not expose a collapsed empty landmark accidentally. Keep details/summary.
entries.acceptance: Responsive collapse, SSR, named landmarks, current links, native navigation and resize focus.

entries.responsibilities: native details disclosure with summary toggle
entries.opportunity: Keep details/summary for native disclosure and SSR interaction capture; moving roles to host does not replace native behavior.
entries.acceptance: Native toggle, keyboard, pre-upgrade interaction, current-link reveal and focus recovery.

entries.responsibilities: named nav and programmatic focus fallback
entries.opportunity: Host could own navigation semantics/layout/focus but requires every nav fallback and responsive direct-jump contract audited; keep native controls/popover.
entries.acceptance: Focus after page replacement, gap popover invokers, responsive layouts, RTL and hidden variants.

entries.responsibilities: native anchor when linked; div surface otherwise
entries.opportunity: Unlinked variant could move surface to host. Linked variant should retain native anchor (href/target/rel, browser link actions); styling on host alone does not move hit area or semantics.
entries.acceptance: Linked versus unlinked switch, open-in-new-tab, focus/hover, nested avatar, rich name and status slots.

entries.responsibilities: named focusable group around members and disclosure
entries.opportunity: Host can own role/name/focus; update explicit [part=base] focus recovery and preserve members layout and overflow dialog.
entries.acceptance: Member limit changes, focused disclosure removed, dialog return focus and host author attributes.

entries.responsibilities: named nav, focusout/Escape and focus fallback
entries.opportunity: Host role=navigation is possible only with focus fallback/query and responsive details/list redesign; keep native summary and buttons.
entries.acceptance: Wide/compact focus recovery, readOnly and disabled state, step replacement and disclosure.

entries.responsibilities: decorative placeholder span, size/shape paint
entries.opportunity: Host or host pseudo-element can paint placeholder; host must become decorative without overwriting consumer semantics. Existing content styles target ::part(base).
entries.acceptance: All shapes, nested placeholder masks, forced colors, size inheritance and aria-hidden ownership.

entries.responsibilities: decorative rotating span inside named status span
entries.opportunity: Move stable status role/name to host and retain one rotating decoration; or retain status ancestor and draw pseudo-element after part API migration. Avoid rotating semantic host/content.
entries.acceptance: Reduced motion, forced colors, meaningful/decorative status naming, animation geometry and CSS-part contract.

entries.opportunity: Host can own label surface, but moving transforms/press animation changes hitbox and focus outline behavior; keep roving focus and IDs on host.

entries.opportunity: Host can own padding/min-size; persistent content stays mounted by existing API. This removes one wrapper, not inactive panel descendants.

entries.responsibilities: bordered paint wrapper around independent overflow region
entries.opportunity: Host can own border/background retaining viewport; alternatively combine base+viewport parts on existing viewport to preserve selector reach but merge two styling/geometry contracts.
entries.acceptance: scrollElement identity, borders/clientTop, sticky inset math, corner clipping, focus outline, print and exportparts.

entries.responsibilities: min-size/isolation around tab-list and panels
entries.opportunity: Host can own min-size/isolation and orientation state. Keep tab-list role and named slots; preserve local stacking above panel content.
entries.acceptance: Vertical/horizontal, focus stacking, panel slots and resize.

entries.responsibilities: inline tag surface around text and native remove button
entries.opportunity: Host can own paint/layout; keep real remove button and cancellation semantics. New current-source component absent from frozen vendor; document its existing base/remove parts.
entries.acceptance: Focus after external removal, disabled/remove state, naming, inline layout and catalog metadata.

entries.responsibilities: article surface, hidden state, pointer swipe capture and keydown

entries.acceptance: Swipe start/cancel/lost capture, Escape, live-region ownership, exit motion, timer pause and focus.

entries.opportunity: Host role=region would include live announcement siblings that are outside current base. Audit accessibility boundary and update focus() plus independent live regions.
entries.acceptance: Queue/history, region naming/focus, announcements, stacking and keyboard dismissal.

complementaryScaffoldingTargets.structure: Native button plus four slot elements and label span; loading indicator is conditional. There is no base part.
complementaryScaffoldingTargets.investigation: Review forwarded prefix/label/default/suffix slot contract and per-instance whitespace/marker costs; preserve native button and naming. Avoid adding observers just to remove slots.

complementaryScaffoldingTargets.structure: Base span + label span + prefix, label and fallback-default slots.
complementaryScaffoldingTargets.investigation: Base removal affects only one of five shadow elements; preserve prefix/label/default precedence and late slot updates.

complementaryScaffoldingTargets.structure: Base plus three region wrappers and three slots; header/footer are hidden when absent, not unmounted.
complementaryScaffoldingTargets.investigation: Investigate optional region/scaffolding costs separately from base migration while preserving future slot assignment, hydration, independent part geometry and region spacing.

complementaryScaffoldingTargets.structure: Stable div[id=description] + named slot + fallback span, including when description is empty.
complementaryScaffoldingTargets.investigation: This is an intentional same-shadow ARIA and SSR/hydration target. Any structural alternative must preserve late slotted descriptions, empty override semantics and label/control association.
